'''Daoud Vari''' was a resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]] who had lost his legs. As a result, he was not conscripted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when they established a [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp|base]] on the world.<ref name="TD" />
